email_subject: Application - Marketing Specialist at Cronos Europa
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing Specialist role at Cronos Europa. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your internal marketing team and help strengthen Cronos Europa's brand visibility and engagement.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I have gained hands-on experience in planning and executing marketing campaigns across digital channels, creating and adapting content for websites, blogs, and social media, and ensuring brand consistency. I have worked with WordPress, Elementor, and various analytics tools to track performance and optimize campaigns. My technical skills in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, combined with my experience in SEO and AI-powered search, allow me to bring a unique perspective to marketing initiatives.

I am particularly drawn to Cronos Europa's collaborative and international environment and the emphasis on continuous improvement. I am confident that my ability to manage multiple tasks, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and adapt content to different audiences would make me a valuable addition to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to Cronos Europa's marketing efforts.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Marketing Specialist position at Cronos Europa. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I am eager to bring my skills to your internal marketing team and contribute to enhancing Cronos Europa's brand visibility, positioning, and engagement.

In my recent roles as a freelance digital marketer and junior digital marketer at Episto, I have been responsible for planning and executing marketing campaigns across various digital channels, including websites, email, and social media. I have created and adapted content for different audiences, ensuring consistency in messaging and brand tone. For example, at Episto, I managed CMS content for client websites, wrote SEO-optimized blog posts, and used tools like Semrush, Ahrefs, and Google Analytics to track performance and inform improvements. My technical background in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, combined with my experience in SEO and AI search optimization, allows me to approach marketing with a data-driven and innovative mindset.

I have also worked on building and optimizing websites for clients, such as mirook.com, where I implemented structured data and ran technical SEO audits to improve search visibility. This experience has honed my ability to manage multiple projects, collaborate with team members, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. I am comfortable using design tools like Canva to create visual content and have a keen eye for clear, engaging communication.

Cronos Europa's collaborative and international environment, along with its commitment to quality and continuous improvement, aligns with my own values. I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to a broad range of marketing initiatives, from content and campaigns to events and performance analysis, and to help strengthen Cronos Europa's market presence.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills and experiences can benefit your team.

Sincerely,
